t: Forge Steel VDE precision screwdriver set with mixed tips contains essential insulated hand tools for electrical professionals, precision tasks and for working with small screw slots. The 6-piece VDE set is rated for safe working up to 1000V, making it ideal for electricians working on demanding installations. Each screwdriver features durable chrome vanadium steel blades and an ergonomic bi-material soft-grip handle for comfortable, controlled use. Magnetised tips securely hold fasteners, and the carry case supplied ensures organised storage and easy transport for tradespeople on site.
b: Contents: SL1.8, SL2, SL2.5, SL3, PH0 & PH00.
